## What changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `bundle exec rake` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/reference.md` for options, flags, outputs or commands; README if user-facing)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated under Unreleased (**Breaking**, with how to update, for public API changes)
- [ ] If results change: `rake benchmark` run before and after, with what changed per view
- [ ] No real or private site data anywhere (code, tests, examples, screenshots)
- [ ] Security considered: untrusted input capped and checked, text escaped, no SQL from map data
